daily-incubator-refresh.title: Daily Incubator Refresh
daily-incubator-refresh.does: Refreshes the incubator, the holding pen for ideas not yet ready to act on.

weekly-incubator-builder.title: Weekly Incubator Builder
weekly-incubator-builder.does: Builds the weekly set of new ideas for the incubator.
weekly-incubator-builder.breaks: The incubator gets no new ideas each week.

finviz-proactive-research.title: Finviz Proactive Research
finviz-proactive-research.does: Scans Finviz several times a market day for notable movers worth a look.

hermes-research-worker-pool.title: Hermes Research Worker Pool
hermes-research-worker-pool.does: Runs the pool of workers that process queued Hermes research tasks hourly.

investment-costs.title: Investment Costs Report
investment-costs.does: Computes what your investments cost in fees and expenses each market day.
investment-costs.breaks: Fee and cost figures go stale.

heartbeat-watch.title: Heartbeat Watch
heartbeat-watch.does: Checks that key jobs are still sending their I-am-alive signals.
heartbeat-watch.breaks: A silently stopped job may go unnoticed.

finviz-sector-research.title: Finviz Sector Research
finviz-sector-research.does: Reviews sector performance on Finviz twice a market day.

proposal-backtest-engine.title: Proposal Backtest Engine
proposal-backtest-engine.does: Tests how trade proposals would have done on past data during the day.

hermes-scope-governor.title: Hermes Scope Governor
hermes-scope-governor.does: Keeps Hermes research within its allowed scope and budget.
hermes-scope-governor.breaks: Hermes could research too widely or overspend.

hermes-score-event-feeder.title: Hermes Score Event Feeder
hermes-score-event-feeder.does: Feeds score-changing events into the Hermes scoring system.
hermes-score-event-feeder.breaks: Hermes scores update more slowly after news.

trade-thesis-review-engine.title: Trade Thesis Review
trade-thesis-review-engine.does: Reviews whether each open trade's original reason still holds.
trade-thesis-review-engine.breaks: Stale trade theses are not flagged.

finviz-market-movers.title: Finviz Market Movers
finviz-market-movers.does: Grabs the biggest market movers from Finviz every 15 minutes during the day.
finviz-market-movers.breaks: The movers list is stale or empty.

aegis-evening-packet.title: Aegis Evening Packet
aegis-evening-packet.does: Builds the Aegis evening summary of the day's findings.
aegis-evening-packet.breaks: The evening research summary is missing.

advisory-desk-run-now.title: Advisory Desk Run Now
advisory-desk-run-now.does: On-demand rebuild of the advisory desk facts and AI opinions.
advisory-desk-run-now.breaks: The Run now button for advisory desk refresh stops working.

analyst-prospectus-generate.title: Analyst Prospectus Generator
analyst-prospectus-generate.does: On-demand creation of a research prospectus for one symbol or a batch.

aegis-brief-regenerate.title: Aegis Brief Regenerate
aegis-brief-regenerate.does: On-demand rebuild of today's Aegis morning brief without resending alerts.
aegis-brief-regenerate.breaks: The regenerate brief button stops working.

hermes-source-curation.title: Hermes Source Curation
hermes-source-curation.does: Curated the list of Hermes research sources.

hermes-discovery-yield-builder.title: Hermes Discovery Yield Builder
hermes-discovery-yield-builder.does: Measured which discovery sources produced useful ideas.

siem-to-hermes-backlog.title: Security Log to Hermes Backlog
siem-to-hermes-backlog.does: Moved security log items into the Hermes queue.

momentum-lifecycle-monitor.title: Momentum Lifecycle Monitor
momentum-lifecycle-monitor.does: Checks the health of momentum ideas from start to expiry.
momentum-lifecycle-monitor.breaks: Stuck or stale momentum ideas go unnoticed.

momentum-cache-reconcile.title: Momentum Cache Reconcile
momentum-cache-reconcile.does: Rebuilds the shared momentum summary from its source snapshots.
momentum-cache-reconcile.breaks: The shared momentum summary can drift from the true data.

tmp-scratch-cleanup.title: Scratch Folder Cleanup
tmp-scratch-cleanup.does: Deletes old temporary scratch files from disk.
tmp-scratch-cleanup.breaks: Temporary files build up and can fill the disk.

hermes-learning-outcome-grader.title: Hermes Outcome Grader Step
hermes-learning-outcome-grader.does: Grades how past Hermes ideas turned out.

hermes-learning-outcome-learning.title: Hermes Outcome Learning Step
hermes-learning-outcome-learning.does: Learns lessons from graded Hermes outcomes.

hermes-learning-config-governor.title: Hermes Config Governor Step
hermes-learning-config-governor.does: Adjusts Hermes settings within safe limits based on results.
hermes-learning-config-governor.breaks: Hermes settings stop being tuned to results.

hermes-learning-tag-engine.title: Hermes Tag Engine Step
hermes-learning-tag-engine.does: Tags Hermes ideas by theme to see which themes work.

hermes-learning-outcome-feedback-agent.title: Hermes Outcome Feedback Step
hermes-learning-outcome-feedback-agent.does: Planned step feeding outcomes back to Hermes; not scheduled.
hermes-learning-outcome-feedback-agent.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

hermes-learning-autonomous-self-tune.title: Hermes Self-Tune Step
hermes-learning-autonomous-self-tune.does: Lets Hermes make small self-adjustments based on results.

hermes-discovery-yield-on-learning.title: Hermes Discovery Yield
hermes-discovery-yield-on-learning.does: Measures which discovery sources yield good ideas whenever new learning arrives.

agent-intelligence-cron-deep.title: Agent Intelligence Deep Run
agent-intelligence-cron-deep.does: Ran the deep agent intelligence update.

agent-intelligence-cron-daily.title: Agent Intelligence Daily Run
agent-intelligence-cron-daily.does: Ran the daily agent intelligence update.

agent-intelligence-cron-intraday.title: Agent Intelligence Intraday Run
agent-intelligence-cron-intraday.does: Ran the intraday agent intelligence update.

cleanup-stale-locks.title: Stale Lock Cleanup
cleanup-stale-locks.does: Cleared leftover lock files from crashed jobs.

indicator-engine.title: Technical Indicator Engine
indicator-engine.does: Calculates technical indicators such as moving averages and RSI before the open.
indicator-engine.breaks: Technical indicators go stale and chart signals are off.

watchlist-entry-planner-limit.title: Watchlist Entry Planner (Limit)
watchlist-entry-planner-limit.does: Plans limit-order entry levels for watchlist names.
watchlist-entry-planner-limit.breaks: Planned entry prices for watchlist names go stale.

watchlist-entry-planner-scope.title: Watchlist Entry Planner (Scope)
watchlist-entry-planner-scope.does: Plans entry levels for a chosen scope of watchlist names.
watchlist-entry-planner-scope.breaks: Entry plans for the chosen names go stale.

run-research-intelligence-overnight.title: Overnight Research Intelligence
run-research-intelligence-overnight.does: Builds the full research intelligence set overnight on weekdays.
run-research-intelligence-overnight.breaks: Research intelligence is stale the next morning.

run-research-intelligence-overnight-arch.title: Research Intelligence Archive
run-research-intelligence-overnight-arch.does: Archives the overnight research intelligence output.
run-research-intelligence-overnight-arch.breaks: Past research snapshots are not archived.

incubator-rolloff-engine.title: Incubator Roll-Off
incubator-rolloff-engine.does: Removes stale or failed ideas from the incubator after the close.
incubator-rolloff-engine.breaks: The incubator fills with dead ideas.

wire-advisory-lessons.title: Advisory Lessons Wiring
wire-advisory-lessons.does: Feeds lessons learned back into the advice system every six hours.

pattern-extractor.title: Pattern Extractor
pattern-extractor.does: Monthly review of history to find repeating winning and losing patterns.
pattern-extractor.breaks: Monthly pattern findings are not produced.

hermes-discovery-scorecard.title: Hermes Discovery Scorecard
hermes-discovery-scorecard.does: Scores how well Hermes discovery sources are doing.

release-window.title: Release Window
release-window.does: Planned job marking the window when releases may happen; never turned on.
release-window.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

nightly-cutover-controller.title: Nightly Cutover Controller
nightly-cutover-controller.does: Planned controller for moving jobs into n8n overnight; currently disarmed.
nightly-cutover-controller.breaks: Automatic overnight cutovers do not happen (paused on purpose).

disk-usage-monitor.title: Disk Usage Monitor
disk-usage-monitor.does: Watches disk space and warns when it runs low.
disk-usage-monitor.breaks: You may not get warned before the disk fills up.

disk-hygiene.title: Disk Hygiene
disk-hygiene.does: Cleans up old files to keep disk space free.
disk-hygiene.breaks: Old files accumulate and disk space shrinks.

tmp-hygiene.title: Temp Folder Hygiene
tmp-hygiene.does: Checks temporary folders for leftover files.

tmp-hygiene-apply.title: Temp Hygiene Auto Cleanup
tmp-hygiene-apply.does: Planned automatic temp cleanup; never turned on.
tmp-hygiene-apply.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

tmp-hygiene-pressure.title: Temp Hygiene Pressure Cleanup
tmp-hygiene-pressure.does: Planned cleanup of temp files when disk is tight; never turned on.
tmp-hygiene-pressure.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

agent-claim-compact.title: Agent Claim Compaction
agent-claim-compact.does: Planned tidy-up of the agent work-claim log; never turned on.
agent-claim-compact.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

hermes-watchlist-scorer.title: Hermes Watchlist Scorer
hermes-watchlist-scorer.does: Scores every watchlist name with Hermes research.

archive-offbox-sync.title: Off-Box Archive Sync
archive-offbox-sync.does: Planned copy of archives to another machine; never turned on.
archive-offbox-sync.breaks: Never scheduled, so nothing is lost today.

cio-portfolio-thesis.title: CIO Portfolio Thesis
cio-portfolio-thesis.does: Builds the CIO's overall written view of your portfolio.
cio-portfolio-thesis.breaks: The portfolio thesis shown by the CIO goes stale.

advisory-maturity-evidence.title: Advisory Maturity Evidence
advisory-maturity-evidence.does: Refreshes the evidence on how reliable the advice system has become.
advisory-maturity-evidence.breaks: The advice maturity report goes stale.

schwab-position-sync.title: Schwab Position Sync
schwab-position-sync.does: Reads your current positions from Schwab, read-only.
schwab-position-sync.breaks: Holdings shown may not match what the broker has.

schwab-stream-daemon.title: Schwab Streaming Capture
schwab-stream-daemon.does: Keeps a read-only live stream of quotes from Schwab running.
schwab-stream-daemon.breaks: Live quote streaming from Schwab stops.

sync-basis-from-broker.title: Cost Basis Sync
sync-basis-from-broker.does: Reads cost basis for holdings from the broker.
sync-basis-from-broker.breaks: Gains and losses may be computed from wrong cost basis.

audit-position-basis.title: Position Basis Audit
audit-position-basis.does: Read-only check comparing cost basis across sources to catch mismatches.
audit-position-basis.breaks: Wrong cost-basis figures could go unnoticed.

grok-stop-review.title: Grok Stop Review
grok-stop-review.does: Has Grok review protective stop levels on top of the technical rules.
grok-stop-review.breaks: Stops lose the outside AI second opinion.

coder-dispatch.title: Coder Dispatch
coder-dispatch.does: Hands code problems from the health agent to an available AI coder (paused).
coder-dispatch.breaks: Automatic fix hand-off is off; fixes are manual.

stop-drift-alert.title: Stop Drift Alert
stop-drift-alert.does: Alerts when a protective stop no longer matches the intended level.
stop-drift-alert.breaks: A stop that drifted from plan may go unnoticed.

options-chain-snapshot.title: Options Chain Snapshot
options-chain-snapshot.does: Saves a snapshot of available options contracts and prices.
options-chain-snapshot.breaks: Options pricing history and views go stale.

defense-execution.title: Defense Execution
defense-execution.does: Carried out defensive stop actions at the broker (paused since the SPCX incident).
defense-execution.breaks: Paused on purpose; defensive stops are not auto-executed.

options-lifecycle-run.title: Options Lifecycle Run
options-lifecycle-run.does: Tracks options positions through expiry and assignment (paused).
options-lifecycle-run.breaks: Paused; options expiry tracking is off.

options-lifecycle-digest.title: Options Lifecycle Digest
options-lifecycle-digest.does: Sends a digest of options positions nearing expiry (paused).
options-lifecycle-digest.breaks: Paused; no options expiry digest is sent.
